_source: Fit360OS workout-routine reference sheet (TUT + Super Set method notes).

items.label: Standard
items.description: Straight sets — perform the prescribed sets and reps at a normal tempo, resting between sets.

items.label: TUT
items.description: TUT is a method in which you will complete 1 REP in 7 seconds — a very slow range of motion. Normally in each exercise you can do 3 sets of 12 reps with moderate weight.

items.label: Super Set
items.description: A superset is when you do two or more exercises back-to-back with no rest in between.
